card.name: Linking words before ultrasound or echo
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets (to, with, on, or, and, parentheses) right before an expected ultrasound or echocardiography term. Also fires on words inside ultrasound phrases like mechanical index.

modes.label: Link before ultrasound
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction that is followed by ultrasound or imaging as the next word.
modes.example: consider monitoring<< with>> ultrasound for oligohydramnios

modes.label: Bracket before abbreviation
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after an imaging method, where the abbreviation (ECHO, USS) comes next.
modes.example: Ultrasound scanning<< (>>USS) with a high-frequency linear

modes.description: Words in ultrasound scanner terms such as mechanical index.
